# Birch Aluminum

> Birch Aluminum is developing a secondary aluminum smelting facility in Decatur, Alabama, converting aluminum wheel scrap into specification-grade alloys for U.S. industrial buyers.

Birch Aluminum is raising capital to build a scalable domestic secondary aluminum production facility. The company targets ~3.0M lbs/month of finished aluminum, ~$73.8M annual revenue at full production, and offers 15% equity to the investor funding the deal.

- [Home](/): Company overview, investment opportunity, team, facility plan, and financial highlights.
- [Market Research](/market-research): U.S. aluminum market data, pricing trends, industry drivers, and competitive landscape.
